list_corrupt_files: list corrupt downloaded video files by comparing local file size to expected S3 content size
check_file_corruption: check if a single downloaded video file is corrupted by comparing its size to the expected S3 size
verify_downloads_integrity: verify the integrity of a collection of downloaded video files and return only the corrupted ones
detect_incomplete_downloads: detect incomplete or corrupted video downloads by checking file path existence and size mismatch
audit_video_downloads: audit a list of video downloads to identify files that do not match their expected S3 content size
